transitions.guard: Fault AND NOT fault_rise AND Ack
Fault AND NOT fault_rise AND NOT Ack

priorities: Evaluate each state's transitions in listed order; take the first matching transition.
Reset clears the alarm only when Fault is false; otherwise it is ignored.
A new Fault rising edge clears acknowledgment before Ack is considered.
A valid Reset takes precedence over Ack.

scan_execution_order.name: Edge sampling
scan_execution_order.action: Sample Fault, Ack, and Reset once. Compute fault_rise := Fault AND NOT previous_fault, then update previous_fault := Fault on every scan.

scan_execution_order.name: Safety/reset priority and state transitions
scan_execution_order.action: Evaluate the ordered transitions using sampled inputs and fault_rise; update state in this scan.

scan_execution_order.name: Unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF
scan_execution_order.action: No timer FBs are required; this stage is intentionally empty.

scan_execution_order.name: Unified output assignments
scan_execution_order.action: Assign Alarm and Acknowledged from the updated state, then assign Horn := Alarm AND NOT Acknowledged. Outputs are observed at the end of this same scan.
